1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.RouteStrips
2 import Mathlib.Topology.Constructions
3 
4 /-! Closing a continuous route family closes its swept strip exactly.
5 The only added parameters are the two endpoint routes, the target edge,
6 and the common source. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
9 
10 open Set BoundedContinuousFunction
11 
12 /-- Evaluate a route family including both edge endpoints and both route endpoints. -/
13 noncomputable def closedRouteStripMap {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
14     (routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve)) : C(unitInterval × unitInterval, frontier P.body) :=
15   ⟨fun p => routes p.1 p.2,
16     continuous_eval.comp ((routes.continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd)⟩
17 
18 /-- Interior times are dense in the closed unit interval. -/
19 theorem interiorTime_dense : DenseRange interiorTime := by
20   change DenseRange (inclusion (Ioo_subset_Icc_self : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Icc 0 1))
21   rw [denseRange_inclusion_iff, closure_Ioo (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
22 
23 /-- The closed swept region is precisely the closure of its open strip. -/
24 theorem closure_routeStrip_eq {P : ConvexPolyhedron}
25     (open_routes : C(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P.BoundaryCurve))
26     (closed_routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve))
27     (agrees : ∀ t, closed_routes (interiorTime t) = open_routes t) :
28     closure (routeStrip open_routes) = range (closedRouteStripMap closed_routes) := by
29   let inclusion : Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 × Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 → unitInterval × unitInterval :=
30     Prod.map interiorTime interiorTime
31   have dense : DenseRange inclusion := interiorTime_dense.prodMap interiorTime_dense
32   have same : closedRouteStripMap closed_routes ∘ inclusion = routeStripMap open_routes := by
33     funext p
34     exact congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe (agrees p.1)) (interiorTime p.2)
35   have included : routeStrip open_routes ⊆ range (closedRouteStripMap closed_routes) := by
36     rw [routeStrip, ← same]
37     exact range_comp_subset_range _ _
38   apply Subset.antisymm (closure_minimal included (isCompact_range (closedRouteStripMap closed_routes).continuous).isClosed)
39   have contains := (closedRouteStripMap closed_routes).continuous.range_subset_closure_image_dense dense
40   rwa [← range_comp, same] at contains
41 
42 /-- Any point added by closure lies on an endpoint route, the target edge, or the source. -/
43 theorem closed_route_strip_added_points {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (a : frontier P.body)
44     (target : unitInterval → frontier P.body)
45     (open_routes : C(Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, P.BoundaryCurve))
46     (closed_routes : C(unitInterval, P.BoundaryCurve))
47     (agrees : ∀ t, closed_routes (interiorTime t) = open_routes t)
48     (member : ∀ t, closed_routes t ∈ P.geodesicFiber a (target t))
49     (b : frontier P.body) (added : b ∈ closure (routeStrip open_routes) \ routeStrip open_routes) :
50     b = a ∨ b ∈ range target ∨ b ∈ range (closed_routes 0) ∨ b ∈ range (closed_routes 1) := by
51   rw [closure_routeStrip_eq open_routes closed_routes agrees] at added
52   obtain ⟨⟨x, t⟩, at_point⟩ := added.1
53   have at_point' : closed_routes x t = b := at_point
54   by_cases time_zero : t = 0
55   · exact Or.inl (at_point'.symm.trans (time_zero ▸ congrArg Prod.fst (member x).2))
56   by_cases time_one : t = 1
57   · right; left
58     exact ⟨x, (congrArg Prod.snd (member x).2).symm.trans (by simpa only [time_one] using at_point')⟩
59   by_cases edge_zero : x = 0
60   · right; right; left
61     exact ⟨t, edge_zero ▸ at_point'⟩
62   by_cases edge_one : x = 1
63   · right; right; right
64     exact ⟨t, edge_one ▸ at_point'⟩
65   have x_inside : 0 < x ∧ x < 1 := ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne x.property.1 (Ne.symm edge_zero),
66     lt_of_le_of_ne x.property.2 edge_one⟩
67   have t_inside : 0 < t ∧ t < 1 := ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.1 (Ne.symm time_zero),
68     lt_of_le_of_ne t.property.2 time_one⟩
69   exfalso
70   apply added.2
71   refine ⟨(⟨x, x_inside⟩, ⟨t, t_inside⟩), ?_⟩
72   change open_routes ⟨x, x_inside⟩ t = b
73   rw [← agrees]
74   exact at_point'
75 
76 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
